interest: Documents postwar demographic pressure, Warren Thompson's birth control recommendations, and regional distributions of foreign populations.
overview: This file documents post-war demographic conditions and population policy in Japan and East Asia between 1945 and 1949 through State Department despatches, SCAP intelligence charts, and demographic reports. Key materials include Warren S. Thompson's policy memorandum advocating birth control to mitigate population pressure, SCAP's preliminary findings from the October 1947 national census, and detailed municipal and prefecture-level distributions of foreign nationals—especially Koreans, Formosans, Chinese, and Russians—in Tokyo and Mukden, Manchuria.
